facts.text: The Mustangs Guarantee Program covers the remaining balance of tuition and mandatory fees not covered by other grants or scholarships.

sources.title: Mustangs Guarantee Program - MSU Texas
sources.quote: The Mustangs Guarantee Program will cover the remaining balance of any tuition and mandatory fees that are NOT covered by other grants, scholarships, exemptions, benefits, and/or waiver programs received by the student.
